This is a preview release, published to verify the Windows startup fix below. Please install it on Windows and confirm MuxSU opens and stays on its main screen.

### Fixed

- **Windows: the app vanished a few seconds after opening**: the main window appeared, the whole process then disappeared, and the event log held nothing but a bare `0xc0000409` — no log anywhere said why. The cause was startup order: MuxSU started its mDNS discovery and refreshed the login autostart entry before it had prepared the shared state those things belong to, and between them that takes several seconds. The interface finished loading during that window and began asking the backend for data that did not exist yet, so Tauri stopped there and took the process with it. The shared state is now prepared first, with mDNS and the autostart entry both moved after it. macOS never showed this, not because it lacks the same ordering, but because it won that race every time.

### Added

- **A crash now says why**: until now an internal error ended the app with no message at all, which is why the crash above took several rounds to find. Such an error is now written down before the app stops: alongside the ordinary log once logging has started (`muxsu-panic.log`), and in the system temp folder before then. The file travels with a diagnostic report too.

This version speaks the same protocol as v0.8.2 and pairs and switches with it directly.

### Known limitations

- This build has not been fully verified on hardware and is meant only for confirming the startup problem above is resolved. A stable release will follow once it has been.
- A preview release is never treated as the newest version by the updater, so computers on a stable release will not be upgraded to it automatically.
- The macOS DMG is ad-hoc signed and not notarized with an Apple Developer ID, so Gatekeeper may ask for it to be allowed by hand.
